justification: Both depict quadruped animals in profile, but that is essentially the only shared content: A is a single massive, volumetric, naturalistically modelled beast rendered in the round with a detailed head, while B shows multiple thin, schematic linear animals (and radiating line motifs) distributed in registers across a broad surface. There is no shared relationship, grouping or compositional scheme, and the rendering conventions (solid modelled mass vs. flat stick-like silhouettes) are quite different.
